meta.title: Come Travel With Me | Dean On Deck
meta.description: Interested in joining Dean on a future voyage? Explore his upcoming sailing plans as they are confirmed and ask about traveling together.

content.heading: Come Travel *With Me.*
content.lede: Some voyages are even better together. If you’d like to join me on a future sailing, I’d love to hear from you.
content.emptyMessage: My upcoming sailings will be shared here as plans are confirmed. In the meantime, let me know you’re interested and ask about future options.
